sourceEvidence.label: Passkey availability, account discovery, and guardian recovery evidence inventory

assessment.summary: Separate passkey availability guidance from account authority while preserving one-click onboarding and live-validator verification.

nonNegotiables: Guardian recovery remains independent of passkey backup state
assumptions: The relying party cannot export WebAuthn private keys or force a provider.
Provider-specific second-device readiness requires physical rehearsal.

opportunities.title: Model passkey availability without blocking onboarding
opportunities.summary: Persist verified BE/BS observations and present provider-neutral guidance after wallet creation.
opportunities.diagnosis: The prior BE=0 recovery gate conflated credential availability with wallet authority and had no post-onboarding state model.

evidence.claim: WebAuthn defines BE and BS as credential backup eligibility and backup state.
Discovery resolves a locator and verifies the assertion with the account's live validator key.
Recovery requires a post-registration assertion before validator preparation.
Availability guidance belongs in presentation state and must not change authority.

desiredInvariants: Only the live validator-key assertion authorizes a discovered account.
BE and BS never grant or revoke wallet authority.
The impossible BS=1 and BE=0 state fails closed.
Recommendation dismissal cannot suppress security status or checks.

options.title: Mandatory portable credential
options.summary: Block onboarding or recovery unless backup state satisfies policy.

evidenceCoverage.rationale: Uses backup flags as a gate but cannot prove second-device readiness.

tradeoffs.assessment: Accepts fewer credentials but conflates availability policy with authority and rejects roaming keys.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Rehearse platform, synced, and roaming credentials and compare rejection rates.

tradeoffs.assessment: Adds only a local flag branch.
Valid authenticator-bound and roaming recovery credentials are refused.
Support must explain provider behavior the RP cannot control.
Policy enforcement changes accepted credentials immediately.

residualRisks: BS does not prove a successful second-device rehearsal.

workPackages: Define and enforce a backup-state policy.
acceptanceCriteria: Every accepted credential satisfies the selected flag policy.
migrationNotes: Existing authenticator-bound credentials require an exception or replacement.

options.title: Risk-adaptive post-onboarding guidance
options.summary: Keep authority gates, persist verified availability observations, and guide users in Security.

evidenceCoverage.rationale: Uses BE/BS only for their defined availability semantics.
Preserves locator resolution followed by live-key verification.
Preserves the post-registration assertion before publication.
Creates a dedicated advisory presentation model.

tradeoffs.assessment: Authority checks remain independent while availability risk becomes visible and refreshable.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Test stale-key discovery, invalid flags, and authenticator-bound recovery.

tradeoffs.assessment: No chain hop is added; verified ceremonies add one bounded local write.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Measure unlock duration before and after the local write.

tradeoffs.assessment: Each account stores four bounded observation fields and one bounded dismissal identifier.
Valid recovery paths are not blocked by provider backup policy.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Rehearse synced, platform, roaming, stale-key, and guardian flows.

tradeoffs.assessment: Provider-neutral copy lowers false promises, but release still needs a physical device matrix.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Publish and maintain the rehearsal matrix.

tradeoffs.assessment: Optional observation fields permit incremental rollout and UI-only rollback.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Read records without the optional fields and verify new flows populate them.

residualRisks: Provider-reported backup state may not equal successful second-device access.
RP ID migration can make an otherwise synced credential unavailable.
Guardian availability remains an independent operational dependency.

migrationNotes: Existing v3 records without observations display unknown until a verified assertion.
implementationReadiness.rollback: Remove advisory UI and optional writes while retaining assertion and live-validator checks.

opportunities.recommendation: Use risk-adaptive guidance while guardians remain a first-class recovery path and provider readiness cannot be forced by the RP.

openQuestions: Which provider/device matrix is required for release evidence?
Should dismissal expire after key rotation or time?
